name: DREAMSTAGE Project: Aidreamin!
source:
Six girls with their dream of being an idol and their story unfold thru hardships and camaraderie, will they succeed on having a solo idol event?

English VN based on the real life cosplay idols "Aidreamin!" from the Philippines.
